title.text: Bateaux Parisiens New Year's Eve: Gala Dinner or Champagne Cruise

ratings.heading: Average of 2 booking sites, weighted by number of reviews

pills.label: 21:00 or 22:40
pills.pop_html: Gala dinner: check-in 20:00, departs 21:00, back at the quay 00:30, then dancing on board until 04:00. Champagne cruise: boarding 22:30, departs 22:40, back 00:00.📍 Port de la Bourdonnais: 75007 Paris, at the foot of the Eiffel Tower.

pills.label: Midnight on the Seine
pills.pop_html: Both programs are on the Seine around midnight and start and end at the foot of the Eiffel Tower, so you see it sparkle at the start and the end.

pills.label: Live orchestra
pills.pop_html: Gala dinner: a live orchestra, then dancing on board until 04:00. The Champagne cruise has an audio guide in 11 languages instead.

pills.label: Pommery Champagne
pills.pop_html: Gala: 2 glasses of Pommery (aperitif and dessert), Mâcon-Villages or Pessac-Léognan (1 bottle per 4), water and coffee. Champagne cruise: a Pommery Pop (20 cl).

pills.label: Smart casual
pills.pop_html: Smart casual for the gala dinner.

pills.label: Gala: no refunds
pills.pop_html: The gala ticket can’t be cancelled. Book it once your plans for the night are fixed.

best_for.pick_html: to be on the Seine at midnight by the Eiffel Tower, with a €95 Champagne cruise or a €514 gala from the same pier.
best_for.skip_html: if you may need to cancel: the gala ticket is non-refundable, and the Champagne cruise serves only snacks.

items.q: Is it on the water at midnight?
items.a: Yes. The gala dinner sails from 21:00 to 00:30 and the Champagne cruise from 22:40 to 00:00, both from the Eiffel Tower pier.

items.q: What is on the gala menu?
items.a: 6 courses: lobster medallions, South-West duck foie gras, a veal cutlet with black truffle, matured cheese and a Maison Lenôtre dessert, with 2 glasses of Pommery and wine.

items.q: Does the Champagne cruise include dinner?
items.a: No: a Pommery Pop (20 cl), a smoked salmon bun, a foie gras brioche and macarons. Eat dinner before you board.

items.q: Can I cancel the gala ticket?
items.a: No, the gala ticket is non-refundable, so book it once your plans for the night are fixed.

items.q: How do I get there on 31 December?
items.a: Roads close around the Champs-Élysées and the Eiffel Tower and the métro gets packed after midnight. Reach Port de la Bourdonnais at least 30 minutes early and plan your way home.
